personas.name: Haru Nakamura
personas.a_typical_day: Morning Slack triage across Japanese and English, Bitbucket PR nudges, investor go/no-go prep, afternoon izakaya visits for feedback, evening AWS cost review. Constantly asks if team shipped real progress or just motion.
asks: Break 'izakaya can pay on delivery' into verified units and show real PASS/FAIL receipts, not claims.
Use Brother readiness board to tell me if we can ship tomorrow or must delay, with numbers.
Gate release until finance owner sees evidence-bound delivery, no opinion slides.
edge_cases: Writes outcome in Japanese, expects English receipts for investors.
Tries to ship without receipts; hook should block unsafe release.
Asks vague outcome; expects Brother to refuse and demand plain-language scope.

personas.name: Miyuki Kato
personas.a_typical_day: Reviews marketplace GMV, delivery fees, AWS bills, reconciles wholesaler payouts, chases founder for budget discipline. Needs hard numbers before any release, hates vague done claims and hidden costs.
asks: Prove last sprint's wholesaler payout fix actually passed checks in isolated worktree, show NO-DATA gaps.
Show project memory vault diff: what changed in costs and scope this week?
Block release if receipts are FAIL; give me cost-to-fix estimate before approval.
edge_cases: Demands numbers in JPY, Brother shows USD mixed output.
Approves via Slack English, Jira comment in Japanese mismatch.
Asks for audit pack mid-sprint, not just at deliver.

personas.name: Daiki Saito
personas.a_typical_day: Codes app features, reviews PRs on Bitbucket, fixes AWS deploys, translates specs between languages. Overloaded, needs isolated worktrees so parallel claims don't trash main and checks run automatically.
asks: Run /brother door on plain outcome, split into claimed units, execute in git worktrees with named checks.
Show status and next: which units are PASS, which need rework, what to do now.
Stop hook must catch when I claim done but checks are NO-DATA, force evidence.
edge_cases: Pushes worktree commit directly to main, hook refuses unsafe write.
Writes spec in mixed Japanese-English, Brother must keep evidence linked.
Runs brother auto overnight, expects readiness board update by morning.

personas.name: Yuki Sato
personas.team: drinks-marketplace app team, joined 3 months ago
personas.a_typical_day: Writes small API fixes, runs tests locally twice, asks senior before pushing, scared to break production, checks worktree status obsessively before merging.
asks: Is this safe to push? Show me which named check would fail before I break prod.
Run my change in isolated worktree and give me PASS/FAIL receipts I can understand.
If I forgot a test, block me and tell me exactly what to add next.
edge_cases: Copies senior's command without understanding, expects one-sentence safety answer.
Claims done after manual test only, Stop hook should demand check.
Types Japanese-only and fears English error messages.

personas.name: Hiroshi Tanaka
personas.stack: SAP, GitHub Enterprise, Jira, Java services
personas.a_typical_day: Jira grooming for customer master revamp, GitHub Enterprise PR reviews, alignment with SAP master data team, steering committee prep. Formal approvals required, cannot move without reviewer sign-offs and audit trail.
asks: Use BrotherSBE spec-and-data-prep to prove customer master change aligns with SAP revamp, with approver receipts.
Generate handover-pack with evidence-bound PASS/FAIL for audit reviewers, Japanese first.
Gate formal release until all named checks pass and decisions log is complete.
edge_cases: Change request written in Japanese, Jira approver comments in English.
Tries to merge without SBE verify PASS, release gate blocks.
SAP field rename breaks SQL models, receipt must show FAIL not NO-DATA.

personas.name: Yumi Ito
personas.stack: SQL models, Java services, GitHub Enterprise
personas.a_typical_day: Maintains DWH SQL models, reviews Java service ETL jobs, checks data lineage for thousands of outlets, answers audit queries. Needs proof that model change does not break downstream reports or outlet feeds.
asks: Prove this SQL model change didn't break outlet reports; run SBE verify with data checks and show receipts.
Adopt existing Jira CR into BrotherSBE and keep GitHub Enterprise trace in worktree.
Show brief and decisions: why model changed, data assumed, what evidence exists.
edge_cases: Data prep step has NO-DATA, Brother must not fake PASS.
SQL model passes in worktree but fails on prod data volume.
Asks prove-this-change for single hotfix without full design phase.

personas.name: Kenji Mori
personas.a_typical_day: Reviews change requests, checks security controls, validates audit evidence, attends release governance gate. Demands receipts over claims, refuses releases with NO-DATA and insists on isolated verification and memory vault history.
asks: Refuse any handover without evidence-bound receipts; show Brother review findings with PASS/FAIL per check.
Verify hooks actually refused unsafe writes in worktrees, provide log proof.
Need learn step to capture why check failed for future governance rules.
edge_cases: Reviewer comments in Japanese, evidence in English, vault must preserve both.
Tries to bypass hook with --no-verify, hook still blocks.
Stop hook flags claimed fix without linked check, demands rework.

personas.name: Emi Suzuki
personas.stack: GitHub Enterprise, Jira, dbt SQL, release governance
personas.a_typical_day: Owns monthly release go/no-go, triages PASS/FAIL receipts, blocks NO-DATA merges, runs verify and review passes, publishes readiness board for steering committee.
asks: Show readiness board with PASS/FAIL/NO-DATA counts and block release if any FAIL remains.
Need evidence-bound handover-pack for audit with approver sign-offs and check logs.
Tell me what to do next in one step; don't dump raw logs.
edge_cases: Release notes in Japanese, receipts in English, needs bilingual trace.
Hotfix tries to skip verify, gate must block push.
Needs one-sentence go/no-go for executives, detail for engineers.
